exposure: Artificial rupture of membrane showing meconium
cohort: The study included term gestation newborns, categorized as cases with meconium-stained amniotic fluid and controls without meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
finding: The study described the clinical and anthropometric profiles, noting that newborns with meconium-stained amniotic fluid had slightly higher median birth weight, length, and head circumference compared to controls, and a higher percentage were large for gestational age.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at birth, encompassing maternal, sonographic, labor characteristics, and newborn anthropometry.
birth_weight: Median birth weight among cases was 3010 gm (IQR 390 gm) and among controls was 2950 gm (IQR 635 gm).
gest_age: All newborns were of term gestation, with a median gestational age of 39 weeks (IQR 1 week) among cases and 39 weeks (IQR 2 weeks) among controls.
